ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant high-intensity white central region comprising approximately 85% of the surface area, bounded by low-intensity black pixels at the perimeter and focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white field. Continuous black perimeter band along the trailing edge. Distinctive dark circular and irregular pixel clusters (mottling) scattered across both lobes, with a specific cluster of five annular rings on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the right lobe. The left lobe features a distinct macro-scale rectangular indentation (concave gap) approximately 150 pixels from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows a smooth convex curve tapering to a pointed distal tip. Left lobe displays a complex, irregular convex trajectory interrupted by substantial edge loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several high-contrast annular dark rings; four are located in a diagonal formation on the right lobe, and two are positioned near the lower-central junction.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-scale, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, primarily in the lower quadrant with horizontal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic excision (notch) on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible scarring and pigmentation loss around the fluke base.
other_distinctive_markers: A thick, low-intensity black vertical band or 'peduncle extension' protruding into the white field at the fluke's ventral base.
